unYOLO gives agents controlled access to your credentials.

Set up credential services, connect agents, and review every privileged change before it
is applied.

Usage:
  unyolo <command>

Commands:
  reconfigure  Change the current installation
  remove       Safely remove an installation
  repair       Repair the current installation
  session      Manage unfinished setup sessions
  setup        Set up unYOLO on this computer
  status       Show installation and setup status

Utilities:
  completion  Generate shell completion
  version     Print the installed version

Advanced:
  system  Run low-level host operations

Options:
  -h, --help     show help
  -v, --version  print the installed version

Run "unyolo help <command>" for more information.
